rules.rule: a SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE or TABLE that reads or changes a tenant table with no condition, joined by AND, that compares its tenant_id to a value or ties it to the tenant column of a table that has one, and that does not reach it through a key from such a table
a tenant table joined to a scoped tenant table through a key such as c.id = o.customer_id, with no condition that ties its tenant_id to the other table or compares it to a value
an INSERT into a tenant table whose column list does not name its tenant_id, or that names no columns, unless that column has a DEFAULT in the schema read
a table the configuration makes a tenant table whose CREATE TABLE, with the ALTER TABLE statements after it, has no tenant_id column
a tenant table created in the input whose tenant column is not the first column of any index, primary key or unique constraint, when the input holds a CREATE INDEX
a comment "tenant-scope: allow" with no reason after it, or with a reason that says nothing
a comment "tenant-scope: allow" with a reason on a statement that has no finding, or after the last statement of a file
